theater: 克羅地亞中部與波斯尼亞

battle.name: 926年克羅地亞-保加利亞戰爭
battle.theater: 克羅地亞中部與波斯尼亞
battle.brief: 西梅揚一世趁拜占庭被阿拉伯人圍困君士坦丁堡、無力西援，於926年秋率保加利亞大軍入克羅地亞，擊敗大公茲沃尼米爾並取其性命，佔領波斯尼亞與達爾馬提亞內陸，逼沿海城市認宗主；雙方近戰前的火力仍靠角筋木複合反曲弓，亞述弓即其技術原型，而拜占庭援軍因達爾馬提亞城市拖延未能到場。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亚述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 交戰一方是保加利亞第一帝國：沙皇西梅揚一世以普雷斯拉夫為都，國家人口不多而軍隊高度騎兵化，兵制由沙皇親領，兵種包括以鐵鎧與長矛為骨幹的重騎兵、持矛步兵、弓兵與輕裝游騎，攻城時另備配重式投石機與可移動的圍城塔。另一方是克羅地亞公國：內陸由大公茲沃尼米爾以中部山區的氏族軍隊與領地徵召兵為核心，沿海則有扎拉、杜布羅夫尼克等自治城市與各自的艦隊，另有匈牙利方面借出的騎兵。拜占庭帝國並未正式宣戰，卻因克羅地亞的求援與達爾馬提亞的歸屬而被牽入；其指揮系統是皇帝羅曼努斯一世經大將軍與樞密院調度的帝國軍，援軍由利奧·福卡斯率領，並配以一支亞美尼亞部隊與海軍艦隊。
countriesEn: The belligerents on one side were the First Bulgarian Empire, ruled from Preslav by Tsar Simeon I, a state with a small population but a highly mounted army; the army was commanded by the tsar in person and comprised heavy cavalry formed around iron armour and long lances, spearmen, bowmen and light skirmishers, with counterweight trebuchets and movable siege towers added when a fortress had to be taken. On the other side stood the Croatian duchy, whose inland core was the tribal levy and lordly contingents of the central highlands under Duke Zvonimir, while the Adriatic littoral was held by self-governing cities such as Zadar and Ragusa with their own fleets, and by mounted auxiliaries supplied from Hungary. The Byzantine Empire never formally declared war, but was drawn in through the Croatian appeal for help and the question of who would hold Dalmatia; its command system ran through Emperor Romanos I, his domestikos and the Senate, and the relief army was led by Leo Phokas with an Armenian contingent and a fleet.
people: 沙皇西梅揚一世是全場的決定者：他把拜占庭被阿拉伯人圍城牽制、無力西援的那個窗口當成唯一時機，秋天跨境作戰，戰後自稱「保加利亞人與克羅地亞人的皇帝」，以佩拉松的金璽發號施令。克羅地亞大公茲沃尼米爾是另一方的主腦，他先後向拜占庭靠攏並請求出兵，也在兵敗之際身亡；後來的匈牙利編年史記他徒步逃到匈牙利王公居地後病逝。《保加利亞司祭編年史》的作者是一位佩拉松一帶的教會人士，傳統上認為即白衣僧格魯戈里奧斯，他把大軍推進與貝爾格拉德等地的抵抗寫得最為具體。拜占庭方面，來自安納托利亞與亞美尼亞的大將利奧·福卡斯率援軍在翌年反攻，他在特拉揚之門的敗績直接導致帝國改以和談收場；同軍的亞美尼亞部隊則記在亞美尼亞總督名下。
peopleEn: Tsar Simeon I was the man who decided everything: he treated the single window in which Byzantium, pinned by the Arab siege of Constantinople, could not aid the western provinces as the moment to strike, crossed the border in the autumn, and after the campaign styled himself Emperor of the Bulgarians and Croats, issuing orders under the golden seal of Preslav. The central figure on the other side was Duke Zvonimir of Croatia, who first drew close to Byzantium and asked it for troops, and who died in the wreckage of the campaign; the later Hungarian chronicles say that he fled on foot to the residence of the Hungarian prince and died there. The most concrete account of the campaigning comes from the anonymous author of the Chronicle of the Bulgarian Presbyter, a cleric of the Preslav area whom tradition identifies with the presbyter Grigorii, who describes the advance of the host and the resistance around the Bosnian towns. On the Byzantine side the decisive figure was Leo Phokas, the magister who led the relief army in the following year; his defeat at the Gates of Trajan forced the Empire to negotiate instead. The Armenian troops in that same force are credited to the eparch of Armenia.
kits: 卡面那件亞述長弓並未出現在 926 年的戰場上，但它是本戰役雙方弓箭的技術祖先。亞述弓是木、角、筋三層材料合成的短反曲複合弓，弓弭以骨或金屬包覆，亞述人把它架在兩輪或四輪輕車上，由車上弓兵先射、車兵隨後踏陣，這一套「弓兵開路、車兵收割」的用法正是西梅揚大軍的原型。反觀 926 年，亞述弓的直接後裔大量存在：保加利亞與克羅地亞的步兵都攜帶角筋木複合反曲弓與箭袋，弓身比亞述型略短而彎度更急，適合騎射與林地狹谷作戰；箭鏢多為鐵製或骨製，箭桿約六十至七十厘米，箭羽取自鵝羽或孔雀羽。拜占庭方面設有專職弓手（toxotai），重騎兵隨身攜帶短弓，配小圓盾或新月盾、鎖子甲（klibanion）與頭盔，長矛的槍桿中段裝鐵矛，攻城則用配重式投石機。馬匹是雙方真正決定勝負的資產：保加利亞的輕裝游騎與拜占庭的甲騎在 927 年特拉揚之門正面相撞，說明投射武器只是近身突刺前的火力準備。
kitsEn: The Assyrian bow on the card was not present on any battlefield in 926, but it is the technical ancestor of the bows used by both sides. The Assyrian bow was a short recurve composite of wood, horn and sinew, its limbs tipped with bone or metal, and the Assyrians mounted it on two- or four-wheeled carts so that archers shot from the vehicle and the chariotry followed up on their tread. That division of labour, bowmen opening the way and drivers and lancers harvesting the breakthrough, is the prototype of Simeon's host. In 926 the direct descendant of the Assyrian bow was present in large numbers: both the Bulgarian and the Croatian foot carried horn-and-sinew composite recurve bows with a quiver, slightly shorter and more sharply recurved than the Assyrian form, which suited mounted archery and fighting in close mountain defiles; the arrowheads were of iron or bone, the shafts about sixty to seventy centimetres long, the fletching cut from goose or peacock feathers. On the Byzantine side there were dedicated archers, and the armoured cavalry carried a short bow of their own together with a small round or crescent shield, a mail coat of klibanion type and a helmet, plus a lance with an iron head socketed halfway along the shaft; siege work was done with counterweight trebuchets. Horses were the decisive asset for both armies: the Bulgarian light horse and the Byzantine cataphracts came to blows at the Gates of Trajan in 927, showing that the missile weapons were only the preparation for the shock of the charge.
tactics: 西梅揚的戰術是典型的草原式混合打擊：先以輕裝游騎越過山道，擾亂敵方徵召與糧道，再集中重騎兵與弓兵主力於一條通往亞得里亞海的縱走廊推進，避免在破碎的達爾馬提亞內陸分兵；攻城時先以配重式投石機壓制城牆，步兵再縮成盾牆推進。弓箭手不求單兵精度，而是以齊射覆蓋通道與退路，騎兵在己方弓兵射界內纏鬥——這正是亞述弓兵在車上開路、讓車兵收割的傳統在 10 世紀的再現。克羅地亞方面以中部山區的堡壘為依托，徵召來的步兵依地形列陣，騎兵由沿海與內陸之間的谷地向北反擊；崩潰的關鍵在於拜占庭援軍被威尼斯與達爾馬提亞城市拖延而未到，聯軍始終缺少讓弓兵與重騎兵協同的掩體。927 年秋的特拉揚之門是反向示範：拜占庭縱隊深入山道狹隘，遭保加利亞輕騎反覆襲擾後被迫下馬列陣，退路被封，潰軍在暴漲的卡姆奇察河中大量溺斃。
tacticsEn: Simeon's method was the classic steppe mixture of arms: light horsemen crossed the mountain tracks first to disrupt the enemy's mustering and food supply, then the mass of heavy horse and bowmen was pushed forward along a single corridor running toward the Adriatic rather than split across the broken ground of the Dalmatian hinterland; in sieges, counterweight trebuchets opened the walls while the infantry advanced in a closed shield wall. The archers did not aim for individual kills but covered the defiles and the retreat routes in volleys, and the horse fought inside the shooting arc of their own bowmen, which was the old Assyrian doctrine of shooting from the cart and then letting the chariots sweep in, reproduced in the tenth century. The Croats relied on the fortified settlements of the central highlands, the mustered infantry was deployed according to the ground, and mounted contingents struck back down the valleys linking the coast to the interior; their collapse came from the absence of Byzantine help, since the aid was delayed by Venice and the Dalmatian cities and the allied army never obtained the cover that allowed bows and heavy horse to work together. The Gates of Trajan in the autumn of 927 was the reverse lesson: a Byzantine column pushed deep into a narrow mountain road, harried by Bulgarian light horse, was forced to fight on foot with its line of retreat sealed, and the fugitives were drowned in the swollen Kamtshitsa river.
data: 這場戰爭留下的數字很少，可靠者集中在日期、距離與地理。西梅揚的進軍在 926 年秋，時序上緊接阿拉伯人圍攻君士坦丁堡（7 月開始、8 月底解圍）之後，拜占庭的注意力與兵力被牽制在西都之門；保加利亞軍隊由普雷斯拉夫南下，跨越索菲亞盆地與克羅地亞東部山道，行程數百公里後才進入交戰區。亞述弓可作對照：其有效射程約一百五十至二百米，而 10 世紀巴爾干使用的角筋木複合反曲弓有效射程約一百米上下，正落在兩百到三百米這個騎兵交鋒前的射擊距離之內。史料未留下 926 年兩軍的確切兵力，只有「大軍」一類的概括；相對可追的是 927 年拜占庭援軍的編成與損失：該軍由安納托利亞與亞美尼亞兩支部隊及一支艦隊組成，在特拉揚之門覆滅，編年史說多數溺斃者死在河中，軍營其後又流行疫疾。此戰後不到一年，保加利亞軍已能圍困塞爾迪卡，顯示其遠程投射與圍城能力延伸至伊什卡爾河上游一帶。
dataEn: Little survives in the way of numbers, and what can be relied on concerns dates, distances and geography. Simeon's advance came in the autumn of 926, immediately after the Arab siege of Constantinople that began in July and was lifted at the end of August, with Byzantine attention and troops pinned at the gates of the capital; the Bulgarian host came south from Preslav, crossed the basin of Sofia and the mountain tracks of eastern Croatia, and covered a march of several hundred kilometres before reaching the ground on which the fighting happened. The Assyrian bow offers a useful comparison: its effective range was about one hundred fifty to two hundred metres, whereas the horn-and-sinew composite recurve bow used in the Balkan in the tenth century reached roughly one hundred metres, an effective range that fits neatly into the two to three hundred metres of shooting distance in front of cavalry contact. The sources give no exact strength for the armies of 926, only generalities about a great host; what can be followed more closely is the composition and the losses of the Byzantine relief force of 927, drawn from the Anatolian and Armenian themes together with a fleet, which was destroyed at the Gates of Trajan, where the chroniclers say most of the drowned perished in the river and where disease then swept the camp. Within less than a year the Bulgarian army was besieging Serdica, which shows that its reach in siegecraft and in mounted screen work now extended to the upper reaches of the Iskar.
cause: 起因是一條外交線的破裂。10 世紀初的拜占庭為了牽制保加利亞，長期扶植克羅地亞大公茲沃尼米爾：925 年前後他受洗並從君士坦丁堡取得「克羅地亞首長」的頭銜，其妹西奧多拉又嫁給保加利亞沙皇鮑里斯，這本是把三方綁在一起的安排。但西梅揚不能容忍一個同時向拜占庭靠攏的西鄰；926 年春，茲沃尼米爾正式向拜占庭請求出兵援助，這一請求決定了戰爭的引信。真正的斷點出在拜占庭使節身上：威尼斯與扎拉等達爾馬提亞城市不願看到拜占庭與克羅地亞的聯軍在自己沿岸展開，也不願保加利亞勢力南下逼近自己的航路，使節在前往克羅地亞途中被拖延、扣留，援軍最終沒有出現在戰場上。拜占庭自身則被阿拉伯人 926 年對君士坦丁堡的圍攻拖住，帝國無力同時應付東西兩條戰線。西梅揚算準了這個窗口，把一場私人外交衝突升級為對克羅地亞國土的直接兼併。
causeEn: The war began when a diplomatic line snapped. Early in the tenth century Byzantium had long supported Duke Zvonimir of Croatia in order to pin Bulgaria down: around 925 he was baptised and received from Constantinople the title of ruler of Croatia, and his sister Theodora was married to Tsar Boris, an arrangement meant to bind the three parties together. Simeon could not tolerate a western neighbour moving towards Byzantium, and in the spring of 926 Zvonimir formally asked Byzantium for troops; that request was the fuse. The real break came at the Byzantine envoys themselves: Venice and the Dalmatian cities such as Zadar had no wish to see a Byzantine and Croatian force operating along their coast, nor a Bulgarian presence closing on their shipping lanes, so the envoys were delayed and detained on their way to Croatia and the relief never reached the battlefield. Byzantium was itself absorbed by the Arab siege of Constantinople in 926 and unable to fight on two fronts at once. Simeon read that window correctly and turned a private diplomatic quarrel into a direct annexation of Croatian territory.
impact: 926 年的結局重畫了亞得里亞海東岸的政治地圖。西梅揚在 926 年秋佔領了克羅地亞內陸與波斯尼亞，但 927 年拜占庭在利奧·福卡斯率領下反攻，一度奪回杜伊拉與達爾馬提亞；真正讓保加利亞無法長期佔有克羅地亞的，是在特拉揚之門的敗績與其後的疫疾。929 年議和之後，西梅揚退回保加利亞，卻保留了「皇帝」的名號直到 931 年病逝；克羅地亞付出的代價更大：它失去了 925 年以來建立的統一王權，內陸大公系、沿海城市與匈牙利勢力在此後十年間爭奪同一塊土地，960 至 970 年代的克羅地亞公國在拜占庭的冊封下幾度易主，直到 11 世紀末才再出現以克羅地亞為名的統一王權。就軍備而言，這場戰爭確認了兩件事：其一，沒有可靠盟友的遠征軍在縱深極短的邊境戰區同樣脆弱，拜占庭的敗績並非來自裝備落後，而是來自援軍缺席與戰略失當；其二，巴爾干的軍隊在九到十世紀已經能把投射武器、騎兵與圍城器械組合成可跨區域的攻勢，這正是亞述弓兵配車兵的舊組合在草原與山地的後裔。拜占庭此後把更多注意力放在亞美尼亞與義大利南部，西部邊境則交給附庸與城市自治去維持一份代價高昂的平衡。
impactEn: The outcome of 926 redrew the political map of the eastern Adriatic. Simeon occupied the Croatian interior and Bosnia in the autumn of 926, but in 927 Byzantium counter-attacked under Leo Phokas and briefly recovered Duklja and Dalmatia; what really denied Bulgaria a lasting hold on Croatia was the ruin of that army at the Gates of Trajan and the epidemic that followed it. After the peace of 929 Simeon withdrew to Bulgaria, yet kept the imperial title until his death in 931; Croatia paid the larger price, losing the unified princely power it had held since 925, and for a decade the inland dukes, the coastal cities and Hungarian interests fought over the same ground, with the duchy of Croatia changing hands under Byzantine investiture through the 960s and 970s, and no unified Croatian kingdom appearing again until the late eleventh century. As for arms, the war confirmed two things: first, an expeditionary army without dependable allies is just as fragile in a frontier theatre with almost no depth, and the Byzantine defeat came not from inferior equipment but from absent aid and flawed approach; second, the Balkan armies of the ninth and tenth centuries could already combine missile weapons, cavalry and siege machinery into an offensive capable of crossing regions, which was the old Assyrian pairing of bowmen and war wagons in its grassland and mountain descendants. Byzantium afterwards turned more of its attention to Armenia and to southern Italy, and left the western frontier to be held by clients and city autonomies, an expensive kind of balance.
result: 結果可以分三層看。戰場上：926 年秋，茲沃尼米爾的聯軍在沒有拜占庭援軍的情況下被西梅揚的保加利亞軍擊潰，大公本人身亡，內陸堡壘與波斯尼亞落入保加利亞之手，扎拉、杜布羅夫尼克等沿海城市改向保加利亞進貢或承認其宗主權；西梅揚隨即以「保加利亞人與克羅地亞人的皇帝」自居，用克羅地亞的名號為帝國的西部合法性加冕。戰略上：927 年拜占庭的援軍雖然在利奧·福卡斯率領下收復杜伊拉與達爾馬提亞，卻在秋天的特拉揚之門被保加利亞反擊殲滅，縱隊被封在山道，潰兵在卡姆奇察河中被水衝走；927 年冬西梅揚反手圍困塞爾迪卡，928 年疫疾在雙方軍營蔓延，雙方罷兵，929 年議和，拜占庭默許保加利亞在西部的實際利益，西梅揚則保留「羅馬人的皇帝」名號直至 931 年去世。長期看：克羅地亞保住了達爾馬提亞沿岸的海岸線，卻失去了 925 年以來建立的統一與拜占庭的保護性承認，內陸出現多個互相敵對的勢力，被匈牙利與拜占庭交替扶植；這就是 926 年留下的最後帳面——保加利亞贏了一場戰役，卻在翌年輸掉了一場會戰。
resultEn: The result can be read on three levels. On the field: in the autumn of 926, with no Byzantine relief present, Zvonimir's coalition was beaten by Simeon's Bulgarian army; the duke was killed, the inland strongholds and Bosnia fell to Bulgaria, and the coastal cities of Zadar and Ragusa turned to pay tribute to Bulgaria or to acknowledge its overlordship. Simeon thereupon assumed the style of Emperor of the Bulgarians and Croats, crowning the western claims of the empire with a Croatian title. Strategically: the Byzantine relief army under Leo Phokas did recover Duklja and Dalmatia in 927, but in the autumn it was annihilated at the Gates of Trajan, the column sealed inside a mountain road and the fugitives swept away by the waters of the Kamtshitsa; in the winter of 927 Simeon turned and besieged Serdica, disease spread through both camps during 928, both sides stood down, and peace was made in 929. Byzantium tacitly accepted Bulgarian interests in the west, and Simeon kept the title of Basileus of the Romans until his death in 931. In the long run Croatia kept its Adriatic coastline but lost the unity and the protective Byzantine recognition it had gained from 925; several mutually hostile powers appeared in the interior, alternately patronised by Hungary and Byzantium. That is the final ledger of 926: Bulgaria won a campaign and lost a battle the following year.
